en:
What exactly is this secret?
And who's keeping it hidden?

You'll have to speak to Chairman Kurusu
of the Yomei Alliance for that answer.

Fact is, he's the one who holds
the truth to the big mystery.
The source of Hiroshima's power is...
[You know who I am, right?]
[I'm here for my father.]

[If he's not here...
I can wait inside.]
[Spread your arms.]
[Hands off.]

[I need more booze than
this to talk to that bastard.]

Yo, bio-dad.
Care for a drink?
[That's Kiryu! Stop him!]
[We can't let a yakuza inside!]

[Stay back!
We'll kill you!]
You're in the way.
Move it!
You did this to Lo?
Aren't you impressed?

I owe it all to you, Aniki.
You helped me see this shit.

Don't tell me... You really planned
to die here with Lo, Yuta?
You think that will fix anything!?
Sorry, but...

If Lo and I die here, nobody will
have to come for Haruto anymore.
It'll all be over.

So you're not gonna listen.
Is that what you're saying?
Yo, bio-dad.
Care for a drink?
So, it appears you've learned the truth.

I found out how you're trying
to murder Haruto, you mean?

Just like Masuzoe.
You kill him to shut him up?
Masuzoe is dead...?
Well?
Why have you come here?
I already told you that.
I want you to join me for a drink.
Gasoline?

I'm gonna make sure you Saio bastards
give up on me and Haruto for good.

I'd rather die than keep living as
the heir to this bullshit triad.

So you plan to kill me
and yourself in the process?
How shortsighted.

If you had simply chosen to negotiate,
nobody would have to die here today.
I didn't come to negotiate.
I'm too dumb for that, you know.
There's only one thing I can do now...

I'm going to die here
to keep my son safe.
Just get out of here already.
You don't need to be a part of this, Aniki.
If you die here, what happens to Haruto!?
He'll be able to live in peace.

With me and Lo dead,
the Saio Triad goes up for grabs.

They can kill each other over it for all I care.
The boy won't need to be involved.
That's not what I asked you!

You're really gonna let him
grow up without a father!?
I'm asking you...
This is my last request, Aniki.
As for Haruto and Haruka-chan...
Can I leave them to you?
I mean...
They don't need a punk like me.
Especially when they could have you inst<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
I won't let you abandon them!
You're not dying over something so stupid.
We're all leaving alive.
Don't mess this up for me, Aniki!
This is the only way I can save Haruto!
Fine then...
...I'll have to drag you out by force.

And if you insist on getting in my way,
I'll do what it takes to stop you.
Even by force.

I already decided, this is
the place where I die.

I made this choice like a man.
And then I made peace with it.

Nobody can stop me now, Aniki.
Not even you.

You're being selfish.
This is bigger than just you.
Think about your family!
Let's go.
Sorry about this.
I know you're a busy man.
Hirose-san, was it?
You're a grandfather now.

Figured it'd be nice for you t'see
yer grandson's face once in a while.
I assume that's not why you're here, though.

You wish to speak of
the secret of Onomichi, yes?
You're sharper than I thought.

Truth is, killing you would be
the easiest way outta this.

But Chairman Kurusu's willing t'let you live.
If you leave Japan, that is.
The chairman and I...
We're both tired o' bloodshed.

The Saio Triad has poured a hefty sum of
money into this location in Little Asia.
We have yet to recoup our investment.
So ya don't plan on leaving?
Consider the actions of Kurusu's son.
He murdered the heir to our triad, Jimmy Lo.
As a businessman and as a father...
...I have no reason to accept your request.

I half expected you'd say that.
So I've got a deal for ya instead.
And that is?

Do you plan on killing the child before
my eyes to convince me to leave?
I'll give you Yuta Usami.

I can convince him to take
the reins of the Saio Triad.
How's that sound?
Oh, and if you don't accept...
...I'll tell Yuta everything.
About how this kid here's his son.
About how you wanna murder him.

He'll want less than nothin'
to do with you after that.

Your precious bloodline
will come to an end.

And I know how much
you value that blood stuff.
That what you want?
What will you do with the child?
I'll keep him safe.

I'll make it so that Yuta could never
possibly know about his existence.

To be honest, I don't see why I shouldn't
silence both you and the child here.
Wanna try that?
I promise you'll be the dead one.
Don't think I'll spare yer men, either.
Every last one of 'em, dead.
You overestimate your ability.
My subordinates all carry firearms.
Y'think I care what they're packing?

I didn't expect Kurusu to have
such a reptile in his den.

Oh, and those two goons y'have watchin'
my hideout... Tatsukawa n' Masuzoe?
Pull 'em off me.

The Saio Triad's days
in Kamurocho are numbered.
You have one month.
As fer the secret of Onomichi...

I've lost track of how many men
I've killed to protect it.
Some were my friends.
Some were my aniki.
If you go and reveal it all now...
...You'd be disrespecting their memory.
I'm sure it sounds quite strange to you.

I was in my compound guarded by
over a hundred able men.

And yet, a single old man with a gun
forced me to accept his terms.

After my negotiations with Hirose
concluded...

...I immediately retracted the order I had given
for Masuzoe and Tatsukawa to kill the child.

However, Tsuneo Iwami had already
sunk his fangs into Tatsukawa by then.
Then came the hit-and-run in Kamurocho.
And the child slipped through Hirose's fingers.

He likely thought he had lost
his sole bargaining chip.

Hence, there was only one way for him
to ensure the secret of Onomichi stayed safe.
He needed me dead.

And you're saying Patriarch Hirose turned
Yuta against you to do that?
Is it not obvious?

Who was the one who told you
that Yuta is the child's father?

And who revealed that Masuzoe
and Tatsukawa wanted the child dead?

I expect Hirose murdered Masuzoe
once he was no longer of use to him.
The longer you thrive in the underworld...
...The more bound you become to ideals.
I was bound to blood law.
For Kurusu and Hirose...
...It's the secret of Onomichi.
That's what drives Hirose.

He even sacrificed Yuta,
one of his own.
That is how low he could sink.
You think I'm gonna believe that!?
He'd never.
This is bullshit!
There is only one road to the truth.
Which is?
Reveal the secret of Onomichi.

That will bring the nature of
Hiroshima's true authority to light.
But be warned...
If you do this...

...No amount of preparation
will be enough to face it.

The fact is, he is the one who holds
the truth to the mystery of which we speak.
I'm pleased with our progress thus far.
And we have Jimmy to thank.
You have a worthy heir.
It's not often that my father compliments me.
...Perhaps today will be different.
[Father.]

[You see that burning district
they call Little Asia?]
[It now belongs to the Saio Triad.]

[Jimmy. You shouldn't have gone
behind my back on this.]
[What?]

[I explicitly forbade you from
expanding into Kamurocho.]

[Didn't I tell you we need to stay
as far away from Kurusu as possible?]
[You know damn well why.]
Is something the matter?

[Do what you must to ensure
this deal is called off.]
[Come on. We're leaving.]

Please give my regards to your
father. We must be leaving.
Hold a moment, sir.

Jimmy and I are the only two
privy to this proposal.

My father, Kurusu,
has no knowledge of it.
Oh, and one more thing.
[This is not an offer you can refuse.]
You're quite a devil.

I hadn't realized you were
proficient in our language.

But I cannot help but wonder,
why do you say we cannot refuse?
The secret of Onomichi.

I believe you know nothing
of its true nature.
Isn't that right?
It was only a day or so ago.
Your son and I had a lovely dinner together.

But after a few pours,
he spoke rather ill of you.

He claimed you were blackmailing
Kurusu with an empty secret.
And you fear he may discover that.
He said it several times.
You...!

Men who talk too much after
a drink are easy to manipulate.

Kurusu remains in the dark, though!
It'll be fine.

Do you see why your father forbid
the Saio Triad from coming to Japan?

It was all to keep Takeru Kurusu from learning
that he didn't know the truth of the secret.

That is why he was so intent on limiting
his interactions with my father.
You needn't worry, though.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Your</font_kind> secret is safe with me.

If my father learned the truth, the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind>
he smuggled in would be in grave danger.
None would be spared.
And I don't wish that upon them.

Why exactly have you
lured us here to Kamurocho?
What is your goal in all of this?
In Kamurocho...
...The Tojo Clan shall be reborn.

Tagashira!
Where are you?
Aniki! Over here!
This is the spot the code was pointin' to.

The secret's in here.
It's gotta be!
It's real freakin' rusty...!
Tagashira!
Hirose?
Secrets are funny things.

They only stay secret 'cause someone
works to keep 'em that way.
So it really is you.
Patriarch Hirose.

People shouldn't go digging around
in other people's business.
Right, Kiryu-san?

Down there!
The boss!
He's really here...
W-We gotta get down there!
To protect this secret...
You used Yuta and Haruto.
You took advantage of Haruka, too.
Hey, Tagashira!
Sit tight fer a sec.
I'll explain this whole mess t'you later.

Yer really the one who's been
protectin' the secret o' Onomichi.

What about Yuta, huh?
You tried t'turn him into a murderer!
Get outta my way.
Tagashira'll find it soon enough.
I got no time to waste on you.

Before I let you go,
the Hirose Family needs answers.

They need to know why you've
lied to them this whole time!
Just move already.
Ain't askin' again.
Answer me first.
Hirose!
I told you to stand the fuck down!

You want past...
You'll have to go through me!
Patriarch... Hirose.
B-Boss!
Wh-What's that?
Looks like... I failed...
The hell's goin' on!?
Y-You guys!

I pulled this giant lever back there.
That's what set off this alarm!
Tagashira. This is yer fault?
The... Yamato...?

That's it!
The Battleship Yamato!
That's...
The secret of Onomichi?
Ch-Chairman Kurusu!?
That... isn't the Yamato.

To be more accurate,
it is the Yamato Mark II.
The most classified military secret in Japan.

Y'goddamn punk!
We ain't gonna let this slide, y'know!

The hell's this? I didn't realize
they were hirin' yakuza around here.
Right? No bullshit thug can lecture me!
That's enough outta you.
Really? Yer gonna pull a gun on a kid?

Go on, just try n' shoot me.
Bet y'can't pull the trigger!
Little fuck...
Let's not.
Why you little...
Who the hell're you?

You break into this factory,
but don't recognize its owner?

No matter.
Just hand the gun to me.
Stay back!
My apologies for him.

This only happened because you tried
to punch above your weight, though.
However, you have guts for a youngster.
You seem strong as well.
What's yer point?
Well... I want you to join me.
I can look after you.
I assume you have no family.

And if you continue on with those kids you
came in with, you won't have a future, either.

My friends?
What'd you do to them!?
Nothing. Just a little slap on the wrist.
They're gone already.
When asked who led this little operation...

...They didn't hesitate to pin the whole
plan on you.
Each one said the same thing.
You call those people your friends...

...But considering their betrayal,
perhaps you should reconsider.
Is that what real friends would do?
What do you gain from them?
What's the point of it?

Discard your former self.
Join me.
I will make you into a real man.
That's it.
That's how I joined the Yomei Alliance.
I didn't fit in too good there.
I was always fightin' my aniki.
If I didn't like 'em, I'd hit 'em.

Cause of that, I only ever got sent
on the most dangerous missions.

Havin' a "people" problem?
"Hirose, get on it."
It was bad, but...
Kurusu-san took real good care of me.

After I came back,
he'd always treat me to a fancy meal.
Kept my pockets full, too.

But t'be honest, I was only happy
when he approved of me.

I woulda done anythin'
just t'hear his praise.

All I could be proud of
was bein' good at fighting.
But Kurusu-san gave me a reason to live.

It might've been hard
to say at the time...
...But I was real grateful fer that.

One night though,
he called me in fer a meeting.
Everythin' changed.
Sorry I'm late.
What's up, Boss?
How have you been?
Oh, uh... I'm scrapin' by.
When you look at me, what do you see?

The chairman of the Yomei Alliance.
Oh, and the president of Iwami Shipbuilding.
